shenzhou-24-first-foreign-astronaut-tian.text: Pakistan's first astronaut has just boarded China's space station.
On Wednesday, China launched the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft from Jiukuan,
carrying Pakistani astronaut Mohammad Zishan Ali to the Tiangong Space Station,
the first foreign astronaut ever to board it, and the first Pakistani in orbit.
Ali, a 40-year-old Pakistan Air Force pilot, flew as payload specialist alongside commander
a Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi. The crew entered Tiangong later the same day.
Ali will spend about a week on board running experiments before returning to Earth on the Shenzhou
2-3 spacecraft. Tiangong has been a Chinese-only station since 2022, opening it to a foreign crew

two-italians-killed-drone-attack-kuwait.text: Two Italian technicians have been killed in a drone attack in Kuwait.
The men worked for Rheinmetallitalia, the Italian unit of German defence group Rheinmetall,
and were at an air defence surveillance station when it was targeted on Thursday.
Kuwait's defence ministry said the two men were injured by falling shrapnel after a number
of drones were detected and intercepted and later died of their injuries.
A Kuwaiti and a Pakistani national were also wounded. Italy and Kuwait have blamed Iran
for the attack. Iran denies any involvement. Foreign Minister Abbas Arachi called the incident
suspicious and offered to work with Kuwait and Italy to determine the cause. Italy's
foreign minister told the Senate that Italy will lodge a complaint with the Iranian embassy.

netanyahu-trial-judges-urge-drop-bribery.text: Israel's longest-running corruption trial took a major turn on Wednesday.
Judges at the Jerusalem District Court recommended that prosecutors drop the bribery charge against
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, in the case known as case 4,000.
The presiding judge, Rivka Friedman Feldman, said the bribery charge presents considerable
difficulties and that the chances of conviction are low.
Prosecutors allege Netanyahu granted regulatory favors worth around $500 million to the telecom
company Bezek in exchange for favourable coverage on its news website.
The judges also urge prosecutors to reconsider a second case and to seek a deal in a third
The recommendation is not a ruling, and Attorney General Gallibahara said she will review it.
Netanyahu welcomed the move, calling it a ray of light for truth and justice.

eu-leaders-fail-agree-2028-2034-budget-u.text: European Union leaders have failed to agree on the bloc's next seven-year budget.
After more than 12 hours of talks at a summit in Brussels on Thursday,
European Council President Antonio Costa told reporters,
Leaders were split over the size of the nearly 1.6 trillion Euro spending plan for 2028 to 2034,
with some countries pushing for deeper cuts while most opposed them.
A proposed 45 billion Euro loan for Ukraine is also stuck.
24 of the 27 member states support it, but the Czech Republic, Hungary and Slovakia,
do not, and Bulgaria would join only the non-military part.
The loan would sit on top of €90 billion agreed for Ukraine.
Leaders will try again at a summit on December 17th and 18th.
Costa insists a deal must be reached by the end of the year,
so it can start on January 1st, 2028.
